# Mental Wellness Journal

Luminary is a mindful journaling application for private reflection, mood tracking, breathing exercises, and personal wellbeing insights.

## Main areas

- [Home](/): Daily prompt, mood check-in, mindful activity, and recent reflections.
- [Write](/write): Journal entry editor.
- [Entries](/entries): Reflection history.
- [Breathe](/breathe): Guided breathing exercises.
- [Mindful](/mindful): Mindfulness guides.
- [Calendar](/calendar): Journal calendar.
- [Insights](/insights): Personal journaling insights.
